title: Mu Chen's mother
summary: While Dong Ming and Mo You play out their game and Zhu Tian guards Mo You's back, a divine pagoda opens and Qing Yanjing, a Saint-Rank Spiritual Formation Grandmaster, appears as a spiritual body. She dismisses the Yellow Dragon Sovereign as a mere first-grade Sovereign and, despite his pleas and the Black Dragon Sovereign rushing to help, destroys him, then vows to wipe out the Dragon Demon Palace. The Black Dragon Sovereign threatens her with Master Wuliang, a ninth-grade Sovereign, but inside her pagoda it means nothing; the Palace flees by Blood Escape and two get away, and Wuliang withdraws on realising she is a Saint-grade Heavenly Sovereign. Xiao Xiao arrives to cut down the remaining attackers 'for my best friend'. Mother and son finally meet; she embraces Ling Xi, whom she raised, and welcomes Luo Li as her future daughter-in-law, then fades, telling Mu Chen to make his name in the Great Thousand World. At the Holy Spiritual Academy, Ji Xuan's grandfather concedes they lost by one move, and with Xia Hou and Wang Zhong present Ji Xuan vows to kill Mu Chen at the Spiritual Academy Competition. Far away, the Ancient Pagoda Clan's Grand Elder berates Qing Yanjing for her 'sinful bloodline' and she threatens to drag him into death if he touches her son.
